# Persona audit: front-desk, 2026-05-02 (walk)

Scope: the whole product, every task of front-desk.
Reached: walked in a browser at http://localhost:3000, signed in as a staff member.
The seed has no front-desk sign-in, so the owner invited `desk-walk@example.com` as a staff member and accepted the invite from the test inbox.
The browser stayed 1200 px wide although 768 px was requested, so the tablet width was not checked. Language: the first language only.
This run replaces the read-only report `front-desk-2026-05-02.md`; its copy and second-language findings were not re-checked here.
Personas are synthetic: this report is a lead for the Human, not a substitute for real users.

## Tasks

| front-desk | See which repairs are due and which benches are free | walked | done |
| front-desk | Check a bike in, and hand it back when it is done | walked | blocked: a drop-in shows as "Bench 2", not as a drop-in |

## Findings

### F1. blocker: a drop-in is not shown as a drop-in

- Persona: front-desk. Task: Check a bike in. Evidence: walked. Label: observed.
- Steps: bench view; Drop-in; Create repair for one bike.
- In their words: "Whose bike is on bench 2? It just says Bench 2."
- Seen: the row and the card title read "Bench 2"; no drop-in label (`front-desk-2026-05-02-2/shot-1700000000033-33.jpg`).
- Owner: `frontend-developer`.

### F2. friction: the bench a repair lands on differs from the bench the form showed

- Persona: front-desk. Tasks: Take a repair; Check a bike in. Evidence: walked. Label: observed. Seen 3 times out of 3 with an auto bench.
- Steps: the full form picked Bench 10 and the confirmation said "Bench 10"; the board put the bike on Bench 2 (`front-desk-2026-05-02-2/shot-1700000000020-20.jpg`, `front-desk-2026-05-02-2/shot-1700000000022-22.png`).
  The drop-in form said Bench 10 and the bike landed on Bench 2 (`front-desk-2026-05-02-2/shot-1700000000031-31.jpg`, `-32.jpg`).
- In their words: "It said bench ten. I wheeled it to bench ten. Now the screen says bench two."
- Finding: the auto-assigned bench shown before saving is not the one saved; where it is chosen was not traced.
- Owner: `backend-developer` (assignment at save), with `frontend-developer` for the preview.

### F3. friction: the part-to-order note is not on the board card

- Persona: front-desk. Task: Note a part, read it before the repair. Evidence: walked. Label: observed.
- Seen: the card shows the request "fit a bell" but not the private note "order a chain" (`front-desk-2026-05-02-2/shot-1700000000023-23.jpg`).
  The note shows only after Details, then expanding More (`-24.jpg`, `-25.jpg`).
- Cares about: parts reaching whoever is at the bench.
- Owner: `ux-specialist`.

### F4. friction: the move list highlights a bench that is booked later

- Persona: front-desk. Task: Move a bike. Evidence: walked. Label: observed.
- Seen: the list of benches to move to marked Bench 1 as free although it is held at 15:30 (`front-desk-2026-05-02-2/shot-1700000000027-27.jpg`, `-28.jpg`).
- Owner: `frontend-developer`.

### F5. friction: Hand back and Did not come act at once, with no undo

- Persona: front-desk. Tasks: Check in and hand back; Late customer. Evidence: walked. Label: observed.
- Seen: Hand back set the repair to Completed with no message or undo (`front-desk-2026-05-02-2/shot-1700000000030-30.jpg`).
- Cares about: a wrong tap on a busy day must be visible and cheap to undo.
- Owner: `ux-specialist`; `product-manager` for an undo rule.

### F6. friction: old messages stay on screen and say the wrong thing

- Persona: front-desk. All tasks. Evidence: walked. Label: observed.
- Seen: after a successful move, the cancelled move's message saying no change was made stayed on screen (`front-desk-2026-05-02-2/shot-1700000000029-29.jpg`).
- Owner: `frontend-developer`.

### F7. friction: the desk can book a time that already passed, with no warning

- Persona: front-desk. Task: Take a repair. Evidence: walked. Label: observed.
- Seen: at 14:00 the time grid offered 09:00 to 13:00 as available (`front-desk-2026-05-02-2/shot-1700000000015-15.jpg`).
- Owner: `product-manager` (already an open question in the product-access doc).

### F8. polish: Fast entry has no place for a note

- Persona: front-desk. Task: Take a repair by phone. Evidence: walked. Label: observed.
- Seen: Options holds only the source ("Phone") (`front-desk-2026-05-02-2/shot-1700000000010-10.jpg`).
- Owner: `ux-specialist`.

### F9. polish: the drop-in screen is titled "Fast entry"

- Persona: front-desk. Task: Check a bike in. Evidence: walked. Label: observed.
- Seen: Drop-in opens "Fast entry" (`front-desk-2026-05-02-2/shot-1700000000031-31.jpg`).
- Owner: `ux-specialist`.

### F10. polish: the Created message names no customer or bench

- Persona: front-desk. Task: Take a repair. Evidence: walked. Label: observed.
- Seen: "Saved: 15:30, 1 bike" (`front-desk-2026-05-02-2/shot-1700000000013-13.jpg`).
- Owner: `ux-specialist`.

### F11. polish: a 15:30 repair is marked "Outside opening hours"

- Persona: front-desk. Task: Change a repair. Evidence: walked. Label: observed.
- Seen: the edit form tags 15:30 "Outside opening hours" though the shop is open until 18:00 (`front-desk-2026-05-02-2/shot-1700000000038-38.jpg`).
- Owner: `ux-specialist`.

## What worked

- One screen answered which repairs are due and which benches are free.

## Not reached

- Tablet width (768 px) and phone width: the browser would not resize below 1200 px.
- The second language: not walked; the read-only report's second-language findings stand unverified.
- The customer booking page, on a host of its own, did not load, so repairs came from the dashboard.

## Persona doc gaps

- Task 2 joins check-in, hand-back and drop-in in one success line, so one missing label blocks the whole task.
